briefdescription.para: Perform SQL name normalization: cast name to the upper-case (via Unicode Character Folding).

detaileddescription.para: Casing is locale-independent and context-sensitive. The result may be longer or shorter than the original. The source string and the destination buffer must not overlap. For example, ß is converted to SS. The result is similar to SQL UPPER function.

parameterdescription.para: A buffer for the result string. The result will be 0-terminated if the buffer is large enough. The contents is undefined in case of failure.
The size of the buffer (number of bytes).
The length of the original string.
count of bytes written (or need to be written).

briefdescription.para: Convert z to a 64-bit signed or unsigned integer.

detaileddescription.para: z must be decimal. This routine does not accept hexadecimal notation. Under the hood it calls strtoll or strtoull depending on presence of '-' char.
length is the number of bytes in the string (bytes, not characters). The string is not necessarily zero-terminated.

parameterdescription.para: Successful transformation. Fits in a 64-bit signed or unsigned integer.
Error during parsing: it contains non-digit characters or it doesn't fit into 64-bit int.

memberdef.name: sql_add_int

briefdescription.para: Attempt to add, subtract, multiply or get the remainder of 64-bit integer values.

detaileddescription.para: There functions are able to operate on signed as well as unsigned integers. If result of operation is greater 0, then it is assumed to be unsigned and can take values in range up to 2^64 - 1. If the result is negative, then its minimum value is -2^63. Return 0 on success. Or if the operation would have resulted in an overflow, return -1.
